visual_summary: A battle scene gives way to an interior breach in a metallic chamber. Two monstrous, monkey-like or simian-headed figures project bright beams across the top panel. Below, narration explains that the speaker entered through a breach and saw Aghora on her knees. A glowing infant in a container or aura is dropped or released, then crawls on all fours across a room strewn with damaged robots and bodies toward a kneeling cloaked figure described as his father-mother.
